context:
Goal: rules for building and trusting guards still reach every session that builds or reads a check, in any repo.
Problem (rule): your 11:59 CST picks would move the two guard rules into a claude-settings file that install never copies, so only you can undo that pick.
Based on (read): retrospective, read at origin/main today: both rules are still in the global CLAUDE.md, so the move never landed and nothing is lost yet; no shipped skill covers building a guard or check.
Based on (read): a skill loads only when the model judges its description fits the task, so a session writing a test or CI check in another repo may never load it; the trust-a-guard-only-after-red rule also covers reading any check, not only building one.
Departs from: main keeps both rules in the global CLAUDE.md — b moves them out; c keeps them and adds a how-to skill.
